title: RNASeek: A Cross-Phyla Generative Foundation Model for Multipurpose RNA Modeling and Reinforcement Learning-Based Design
authors: Shiyuan Chen; Neil R. Fernandes; Wei Vivian Li; Lili Wang; Zhenyu Jia; Joy S. Xiang
one_liner_zh: 该文提出RNA生成式基础模型RNASeek，用于RNA序列建模与功能设计，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其预训练-预测-强化学习优化框架可迁移至蛋白质结构/序列设计，对课题有借鉴价值。
abstract: RNA plays central roles in regulating information flow and provides a versatile substrate for engineering biological functions. While large language models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing and protein design, a general framework connecting RNA foundation models to functional sequence design remains limited. Here, we present RNASeek, a 1.6-billion-parameter generative foundation model built on a DeepSeek architecture and trained on a cross-phyla transcriptomic corpus for RNA sequence representation and generation. Natural-language tokens enable flexible conditional prediction and sequence design using a unified backbone. RNASeek captures species-specific transcript features and intron–exon boundaries in a zero-shot setting. We then fine-tune RNASeek to predict ribozyme self-cleavage activity and viral mRNA stability, revealing interpretable sequence features associated with function, including ribozyme loop flexibility and stem stability, as well as AU-rich motifs associated with mRNA stability. We use these functional predictors as reward models and apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to update RNASeek’s generation policy toward sequences with desired properties. GRPO-guided generation produces faster-cleaving ribozymes and stability-enhancing 3′ UTRs while satisfying user-specified IUPAC constraints. Experimentally validated RNASeek-generated ribozymes achieve wild-type levels of activity, while RNASeek-generated 3′ UTR sequences exceed the performance of the training data and benchmarked AI-generated 3′ UTRs. Together, RNASeek establishes a unified pretrain–predict–optimize framework that connects learned RNA function to controllable de novo sequence design and provides a general strategy for engineering regulatory RNAs with desired properties.
abstract_zh: RNA在调控信息流动中发挥核心作用，并为工程化生物功能提供了多功能底物。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）已变革自然语言处理和蛋白质设计，但将RNA基础模型与功能性序列设计相连接的一般框架仍较为有限。在此，我们提出RNASeek，一个基于DeepSeek架构构建的16亿参数生成式基础模型，并在跨门类转录组语料库上训练，用于RNA序列表示和生成。自然语言标记使得通过统一骨干网络实现灵活的条件预测和序列设计成为可能。RNASeek在零样本设置下捕获物种特异性转录特征和内含子-外显子边界。随后，我们对RNASeek进行微调，以预测核酶自切割活性和病毒mRNA稳定性，揭示与功能相关的可解释序列特征，包括核酶环灵活性和茎稳定性，以及与mRNA稳定性相关的AU富集基序。我们使用这些功能预测器作为奖励模型，并应用组相对策略优化（GRPO）更新RNASeek的生成策略，以朝向具有所需特性的序列。GRPO引导的生成产生更快切割的核酶和增强稳定性的3′ UTR，同时满足用户指定的IUPAC约束。实验验证的RNASeek生成核酶达到野生型水平的活性，而RNASeek生成的3′ UTR序列超过训练数据和基准测试的AI生成3′ UTR的性能。综上，RNASeek建立了一个统一的预训练-预测-优化框架，将学习的RNA功能与可控的从头序列设计相连接，并为工程化具有所需特性的调控RNA提供了一般策略。
